change_summary: PLOS ONE retracted this paper on phishing-website detection with a recurrent neural network. The editors say it was one of a series of submissions with concerns about peer review integrity and possible manipulation of the publication process. They say these concerns call the validity and provenance of the reported results into question. The author did not respond or could not be reached. The whole paper is affected, including the reported accuracy and F1 comparisons.
evaluation: The draft cites Dutta (reference [14]) twice. In Section 3 it calls the paper the main evidence for choosing an LSTM and skipping a model-selection study. In Section 4 it takes the paper's model settings as its untuned starting point. PLOS ONE has retracted the whole paper because the validity and provenance of its results are in question. Both uses are affected, so this matters a lot: the model choice and the settings both rest on results that can no longer be trusted.
recommendation: Because PLOS ONE retracted Dutta [14] over doubts about the validity and provenance of its results, and your draft uses it as its main evidence for choosing an LSTM and as its untuned starting settings, raise this with your co-authors or supervisor. Replace the evidence and re-justify or tune the settings.
